title: crunchy beurre-monte shattering corn tortillas tacos
description: Japanese-inspired brunch tacos made with crunchy corn tortillas, tangy beurre-monte, and pickled shiitake mushrooms.
instructions: Make the beurre-monte ingredients by melting the beurre noisette in a small saucepan and whisking in the yuzu juice.
Make the toasted sesame seeds by heating a small skillet and sprinkling in the sesame seeds, stirring frequently.
Make the pickled shiitake mushrooms by heating a small saucepan with the sesame oil and soy sauce and simmering the mushrooms for 2 minutes.
Cut the corn tortillas into quarters and fry in a deep frying basket until crunchy.
Combine the beurre noisette and yuzu juice in a bowl and whisk until thickened.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few pieces of the crunchy corn tortillas on a plate, topping with pickled shiitake mushrooms, scallions, and a drizzle of beurre-monte.
Sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds on top of each taco and serve immediately.
